description: Attaches supplied images to existing Lingard cards. It does not generate images: each entry carries the image itself as imageBase64 or dataUri, or an imageUrl that the server downloads. PNG, JPEG, WebP, and SVG inputs are converted to WebP and uploaded as private custom card images; an image the card already has is replaced. commit=true writes.

commit.description: True uploads and attaches. Default false returns a dry-run preview without writing.

images.description: One entry per card to illustrate. Each entry needs a card selector (`cardId` or `title`) and exactly one image source (`imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`).

items.description: One image to attach to one card: a card selector (`cardId` or `title`) and exactly one image source (`imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`). Every other field is optional.

cardId.description: Card selector (preferred): UUID of the card to attach the image to. One of `cardId` or `title` is required.

collectionTitle.description: Optional: limit the card lookup to this collection by title.

collectionUuid.description: Optional: limit the card lookup to this collection UUID (disambiguates a `title`).

dataUri.description: Image source (an entry carries EXACTLY ONE of `imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`). Data URI, e.g. data:image/webp;base64,... or data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg...>.

imageBase64.description: Image source (an entry carries EXACTLY ONE of `imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`). Base64 image bytes (PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG; converted to WebP).

imageUrl.description: Image source (an entry carries EXACTLY ONE of `imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`). HTTP(S) URL to fetch and convert.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME-type hint for `imageBase64`, e.g. image/png; the server also sniffs the decoded header.

prompt.description: Not supported: this tool cannot create an image from a prompt; it needs `imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`.

title.description: Card selector (alternative to `cardId`): the card's word/title. One of `cardId` or `title` is required.

name: lingard_attach_card_images
title: Attach Lingard Card Images
